earnings.title: Cerebras Systems Delivers Record Revenue in Third Quarter 2026,
highlights: GAAP cloud revenue grew 265% from a year ago
GAAP total revenue: Record $210.8 million, up 55% year-over-year
Core cloud revenue $144.9 million, up 272% from a year ago

quotes.text: Cerebras’ technology remains the undisputed champion of speed.
quotes.by: Andrew Feldman, co-founder and CEO of Cerebras

quotes.text: We exceeded our guidance across the board for the third quarter in a row and delivered sequential improvements on all core financial metrics.
